title: device request body github.connect
description: no parameters: the GitHub device flow the device prefers (the OAuth App when set up, else the GitHub App; KOR-65); app: the device flow of that app; token: store an existing GitHub token (a GitHub CLI login or a personal access token) after the device checked it (KOR-25). At most one of app and token (the device answers upstream_error to both)

app.description: oauth_app: the OAuth App (every repository the account can reach); github_app: the GitHub App (repositories of owners where it is installed)
